# Jhānavibhaṅga (Vb 12)

**ID:** Vb 12
**Section:** Vibhaṅga (vb)
**Collection:** Abhidhamma
**Title (Pali):** Jhānavibhaṅga
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/abh02m.mul11.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

In the broader framework of the *Vibhaṅga*, the text supplies analytical definitions and parameters for meditative absorptions and path factors, which intersect with analyses seen across related treatises such as the *Maggavibhaṅga* and *Saccavibhaṅga* [Anderson 1999]. In Pali commentarial tradition cited by Mrs. Rhys Davids, Buddhaghosa records a legend that the deva Kassapa heard the Buddha expound this text during his preaching of the Abhidhamma in Tāvatiṃsa heaven [Mrs. Rhys Davids 1917].

**Parallels and text reuse**

- Mentioned in: an2.36; Mil 7.3.2 Padumaṅgapañha; DN 2 (PTS DN i 47) Sāmaññaphala Sutta; MN 6 (PTS MN i 33) Ākaṅkheyya Sutta; SN 47.46 Pātimokkhasaṁvarasutta; AN 5.102 Ussaṅkitasutta; Mnd 16 Sāriputtasuttaniddesa; Pvr 7 Ekuttarikanaya; Bu-Vb Pj1 Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pārājika 1

**Sources**

- [Nyanatiloka 1938] Nyanatiloka Mahāthera, Guide Through the Abhidhamma Pitaka (1938) — Outlines the structure of the Sutta-explanation matrix and preliminary training.
- [Anderson 1999] Carol S. Anderson, Pain and Its Ending: The Four Noble Truths in the Theravāda Buddhist Canon (1999) — Notes on path descriptions and definitions shared across Vibhaṅga sections.
- [Mrs. Rhys Davids 1917] C.A.F. Rhys Davids, The Book of the Kindred Sayings, Vol. I (1917) — Cites Buddhaghosa's commentary regarding Kassapa hearing the Jhānavibhaṅga in Tāvatiṃsa.
